text:
megan: FYI telemetry alerted about an uptick in billing-related quota hits where project attribution fell back to org-only. Looks like requests are being charged to org default bucket instead of project.

devon: Oof. Any recent rollout that touches attribution or header rewriting?

megan: We rolled routing-sampler-v3 last night (priority change + a tiny dedupe optimization). Errors started ~15m after ramp.

akira: Quick hypothesis: sampler dedupe step collapses duplicate origins and drops the header that contained the `proj_ref` shim. The binder then only sees org claim in token and picks org bucket.

sam: I dug in. The sampler code uses `origin->canonicalize()` and then `dedupeOrigins()` which now returns a single representative origin without preserving the original header name.

megan: Can you paste the header snapshot for a hit that misattributed?

devon: Example: `Authorization: ApiKey org=org-z project_ref=studio-9 token=sk_...`
Proxy forwards `X-Org: org-z` and `X-Project-Ref: studio-9` but after sampler pass the trace shows only `X-Org`. Authz binder expects `X-Project-Id` or `proj_id` claim.

akira: That's a naming mismatch and a loss-of-origin problem. Two fixes: preserve original header keys in the dedupe output, or converge all components on `X-Project-Id` canonical header.

sam: Short-term mitigation: I'll patch sampler to include a `orig_headers` map in the decision context that survives dedupe. That should keep `X-Project-Ref` visible to the binder.

megan: Any UX work we can do so support can triage faster? The console currently shows "Attributed to org" with no hint.

anil: We could add an inline badge on request detail: "project header lost during routing-sampler" if `orig_headers` != `final_headers`. Also add a quick link to run the diagnostic query that surfaced the spike.

megan: Nice. Add that badge + link. Also let's emit metric `authz.attribution.missing_header_name` tagged with `header_keys` so we can build a heatmap.

sam: Will add metric and prop `orig_headers` change. Pushing a hotfix to infra-staging now.

devon: Rolling hotfix to staging. Can we gate the global rollback on quota telemetry returning to baseline for 30m?

akira: Yes. I'll add an alert rule that fires if `quota.attributed_to_project` drops >10% relative to baseline over 15m.

console-bot: deploy started: sampler-hotfix -> infra-staging (deployer=sam)

megan: Thanks. Once hotfix is up, let's run a small synthetic workload with mixed token types (user key / sa / cross-org) to validate attribute parity. I'll document the test plan in the ticket.

sam: Uploaded PR and test scripts. Will post results in this thread. :thumbsup:
